what: On first open, the speech-bubble stickers and phone mockups pop out from 0 scale, 80px below and −50°, rotating around a lower pivot (50% 80%) and settling upright over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1). Separately, the inner image (bob) runs from the start a never-ending 2s back-and-forth (cubic-bezier(.42,0,.58,1)) bobbing 15px up and down while tilting between −5° and 2°. Pieces inside the image (glyphs — flower, heart, hand) each swing back and forth separately, sharing a set list of values (rotation, size) evenly. The phone flies in from 1500px below at 35° and .8 scale over 1.6s, and the small dot turns on from transparent over .75s with a slight overshoot (optional)

options.delay: Delay before entering (seconds), default 0 — original yellow .8 · sky blue 1 · phone .25 · dots .5~.7
options.ease: Entrance curve, default 0.19,1,0.22,1 — the dot uses 0.19,1,0.22,1.1 (slight overshoot)
options.y: Initial downward offset (px), default 80 — phone 1500 · dot 10
options.to: Vertical position (px) to settle at after entering, default 0 — speech bubbles on the Brand article page use −20·−40 (they stand where they have floated up and over)
options.rotate: Starting tilt (degrees), default −50 — opposite sticker 50 · phone 35 · dot 0
options.fade: If true, it also fades in from transparent (default: it is only invisible because its size is 0, and no opacity is applied)
options.bob: Floating vertical round trip (start,end) in px or a single value (→ that value and 0), default 15 — dots 25
options.tilt: Floating tilt back and forth ”start,end” (deg), default 0 — yellow −5,2 · sky blue 0,−9
options.period: Length of one float in a single direction (s), default 2 — dots 1.8·2.2·3
options.[data-fx-part=bob]: Inner graphic to hang the float on. If none, it applies to the element’s own translate·rotate properties
options.[data-fx-part=glyph]: Independently spinning part — data-keys ”a,b,…” (split evenly) · data-prop rotate (default)|scale|y · data-period (seconds, default 3) · data-wait (seconds) · data-yoyo false repeats from the start · data-origin

from.where: index.html around .hm-phone — yellow bubble (delay .8 · tilt −5,2 · bob-delay .2, flower −50↔2° 3s), sky-blue bubble (delay 1 · dur .8 · rotate 50 · origin 40% 80% · tilt 0,−9 · bob-delay .3, heart 1↔1.05x 2s), phone (delay .25 · dur 1.6 · scale .8 · y 1500 · rotate 35, phone graphic 15px 2s), three dots (fade · scale 0 · y 10 · rotate 0 · dur .75 · ease 0.19,1,0.22,1.1 · bob 25 · 1.8/2.2/3s), two notice pill bubbles (y 40, hand 5,−5,8,−12,12,−8 3s · arrow wiggles on a repeating 4s loop) — all taken from the original framer-motion animate keyframes. article.html header graphic: two sunset bubbles (y 60 · to −20 · delay .8 · 1.2s / y 40 · to −40 · rotate 50 · origin 50% 70% · delay .7 · 1.1s, floating 0,25 · 4,0 / −8,3 · 3s, hand wave · heart wiggle)

note: The original uses framer-motion keyframe animate (repeat Infinity · repeatType reverse), so instead of shipping the same library it is ported to a GSAP back-and-forth (yoyo). framer does not apply the first floating value during the delay, but the outer layer is at scale 0 then and invisible, so the part applies its first value as soon as it attaches
